# Febrero AI: every case on febreroai.com

Source: https://febreroai.com/ · updated 2026-10-29

## Organisational processes
https://febreroai.com/en/work/processes/

An AI layer on top of the systems the company already runs: ERP, CRM, email, spreadsheets. Nothing to migrate and nothing new for the team to learn, so adoption is easy — and processes that take days start taking hours.

### Interactive demo for construction companies (febreroai.com/demo/construction)
A fictional construction company with the AI layer at work: it reads quote requests and floor plans, prepares cost estimates and progress-billing reports, checks supplier invoices against delivery notes and answers questions about the sites. In English, Portuguese and Spanish, nothing to install.

### From drawings to the final model in hours (Construction company · Portugal)
Going from the architect's drawings to the final model (quantities, cost estimate, materials list) took 30 to 60 days. With AI working on top of the ERP the company already used (Cegid Primavera), it now takes a few hours — and everything that starts from that model speeds up with it.

### The team back on site (Febrero AI · construction)
A video for builders: the virtual presenter explains how AI prepares quantities, cost estimates and schedules in a few hours, so the team spends less time at the computer and more time on site.

### From drawings to the schedule in hours (Febrero AI · construction)
A video for builders: turning drawings into quantities, cost estimates and planning schedules took weeks; with AI on top of the software they already use, it takes a few hours.

### Works with any system, nothing to replace (ERP · CRM · email · spreadsheets)
The AI reads and writes where the team already works, whatever the company uses. Nothing is migrated and nobody has to learn new software: the screens stay the same and the manual steps disappear. That is why adoption is fast.

### How it starts (Short assessment)
Two weeks mapping where manual work costs the most, ending in a shortlist of the two or three processes with the fastest return, each with its cost and timeline. Then I build the AI layer and train the people who will use it.

## Communication and advertising
https://febreroai.com/en/work/advertising/

Synthetic presenters with cloned voices, animated from a single still image, with automated editing, music and captions. From script to a publishable ad in minutes and for a few euros — which is what makes weekly content viable for a small business. Pieces like these have passed 50,000 views.

### Portuguese footwear on an AI model (CHAZE)
Three shots of the shoe on an AI-generated model and this 10-second video, delivered within an hour of the brand's request.

### Head-lice treatment clinic (Kids & Nits · Lisbon)
The presenter as the clinic's technician, in a set built from real photos of the clinic.

### Lice diagnosis and treatment (Kids & Nits)
The presenter in a bubble over the clinic's images: free diagnosis, one-session hot-air treatment and the preventive range.

### Nail studio (Dez Studio · Lisbon)
AI-animated nail art, with the presenter inviting viewers to book.

### Hair and beauty salon (MJF · Olivais Shopping)
The presenter invites viewers to book, over footage of the salon itself, with the phone number at the end.

### Bridal shoes without a photo shoot (Anna Walker Boutique)
The shop's shoe worn by an AI-generated model and animated, with the presenter walking through the details.

### Fashion-from-TV app (agrada.me)
From the soap-opera look to checkout in two taps: the presenter shows how the app works, with brand, price and where to buy.

### Shoe cleaning and restoration (SOLVE · Lisbon)
The presenter in a bubble over the shop's own edit, with its original music underneath.

### Ad for a pilates studio (Retainer client)
Posture mistakes explained in seconds, then the invitation to a trial class. Produced end to end by the system.

### Edit made from the studio's own footage (Retainer client)
Clinical pilates explained over real footage of the studio, ending with the trial-class invitation.

### Neighbourhood yoga centre (Centro do Yoga do Lumiar)
Open since 2015, next to the metro and with 300+ reviews: small classes and evening sessions, in 23 seconds.

### Movement studio (CORE Studio · Lumiar)
Yoga, pilates, stretching and dance, always with someone alongside: the studio in 15 seconds.

### Restaurant ad (Vila Alice)
Room, table and full house generated by AI, with the brand applied — no shoot required.

### Brand film (Gigacorp)
Story, voices and footage generated by AI for my own local-marketing operation.

### Neighbourhood shopping centre (CC Pontinha)
The presenter in a bubble over the centre's own footage, with Portuguese guitar underneath.

### A welcome to the shopping centre (CC Pontinha)
Flowers, phones, clothing repairs, a barber and a café: the centre's shops in 9 seconds, five minutes from the metro.

### Dental clinic (Imed · Parque das Nações)
Six seconds: where the clinic is, who it is for, and the invitation to book.

### Class content (Pilates studio)
An exercise explained over real footage of the studio — the format that feeds the social accounts every week.

### Animated meme (Viral format)
Cartoon-style AI animation, the kind that travels on social and buys reach without a media budget.

## Stays and real estate
https://febreroai.com/en/work/stays-real-estate/

Short videos for country houses, rural tourism, glamping and property developments, made from the photos the place already has — nobody needs to go and film. Each one ends with the contacts and where to book.

### Family estate in the Algarve (Quinta Magnólia · Mexilhoeira Grande)
The estate's activities — beach volleyball, trampoline, outdoor games — animated from the photos on its website, with the presenter inviting families on holiday.

### Rural tourism and award-winning honey (Apimonte · Montesinho Natural Park)
Stone houses with fireplaces and the family's apiaries, animated from the photos in their own brochure, with birdsong under the music.

### Country house (Casa da Eira · Tábua)
A schist cottage presented in 15 seconds, from footage of the house itself.

### Glamping, Halloween edition (Green Paradise Glamping · Vila Nova de Cerveira)
A seasonal video made from the glamping's photos: pumpkins on the porch, the lit hot tub and, at the end, where to book.

### House in the Serra da Estrela (Casa Pelourinho · Melo, Gouveia)
A granite house rated 9.5 on Booking, presented in 10 seconds from the photos in its listing.

### A presenter selling property (Bond Maison Concierge)
The development's concierge introduces herself and explains what she does — the same character who then answers on Telegram.

## Client acquisition and sales
https://febreroai.com/en/work/clients-sales/

Systems that find the customer, talk to them, and hand me only the decision.

### Prospecting and reply machine (Own operation)
A database of roughly 4,900 companies, each with an automated audit of its online presence. The system picks who to contact, writes a message fitted to that business, sends on a schedule, reads the replies, classifies them and drafts the answer — which only goes out once I approve it from my phone. Deliveries, opens and bounces are measured and feed back into the rules.

### Management bots (Inside the company)
Assistants for running the business: talk to them by message or by voice, ask what is going on in the company, follow markets, and prepare or execute buy and sell orders.

### Personal assistant for real estate (Bond Maison Concierge)
A concierge with voice and video answers on Telegram, walks buyers through the developments and follows the construction live, around the clock.

### Campaign and book site (remigracao.com)
Landing and sales page for Afonso Gonçalves' book on immigration policy, with the author's context and proposal.

## Commerce and retail
https://febreroai.com/en/work/commerce-retail/

Turning content and collections into something you can buy in one tap.

### Shoppable television (SIC Shop)
Every garment worn on the shows is buyable in one tap, organised by contestant and by episode.

### Digital card binder (fuse.cards)
Organise a collection across pages, import card lists, and fuse two cards into a new one in the fuse lab.

## Assets, markets and Web3
https://febreroai.com/en/work/markets-web3/

Where the asset's economics are the product: economic design, the market, and the platform under it.

### Lusitano horses as an asset (pump.horse)
Mantovani Horses' platform: fractional economic exposure to elite Lusitano dressage horses, with price history, shares and raffles.

### Crypto market dashboard (memes.army)
Live prices, a return index and a battle map showing where the buying and selling pressure sits.

## Tourism and web experiences
https://febreroai.com/en/work/web-experiences/

Sites that sell the experience, and experiences that only exist in the browser.

### Tourism booking site (Alentours · Évora)
For a family business in Évora: Land Rover tours across the Alentejo, with routes, gallery and online booking in Portuguese and English.

### Browser arcade game (trenches.wtf)
A 3D trench run with multiplayer and leaderboards — a test of how much fits inside a web page.
